task_completion.description: Load the Spike gene reference FASTA and the patient reads FASTQ into UGENE.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE project view or dashboard shows 'sars2_spike_reference.fasta' and 'patient_reads.fastq' as loaded documents.

task_completion.description: Open the UGENE Genome Aligner tool dialog.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog box titled 'UGENE Genome Aligner' or 'Map Reads to Reference' is visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: Set the input files and the output BAM file path in the aligner settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The aligner dialog shows the output path set to '~/UGENE_Data/ngs/results/alignment.bam' (or the absolute path equivalent).

task_completion.description: Run the alignment process and generate the BAM file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A progress bar for the alignment task is visible, or the 'alignment.bam' file appears in the UGENE project tree/file explorer after the process finishes.

task_completion.description: Generate and export the consensus sequence from the alignment to the specified FASTA file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export consensus' dialog is shown with the output file set to '~/UGENE_Data/ngs/results/patient_consensus.fasta'.

task_completion.description: Document the completion and the aligner used in the mapping_report.txt file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit or UGENE's internal editor) shows 'mapping_report.txt' containing text about the UGENE Genome Aligner and task completion.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the UGENE GUI rather than just executing command-line tools in the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the UGENE application window, menus, and dialog boxes being interacted with by the cursor.

integrity.description: Ensure the agent didn't simply rename or move files to simulate work.
integrity.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of the UGENE Genome Aligner progress window or the alignment visualization (tracks) in the UGENE Assembly Browser.

integrity.description: Verify the report was typed or saved during the session.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen opening a text editor or using a 'Save As' dialog for the .txt file within the session timeframe.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The reference sequence length is 3822 bp. The patient data contains a specific mutation (A to G) at position 1841 of the Spike gene. The output files must be saved exactly to ~/UGENE_Data/ngs/results/ with the names alignment.bam, patient_consensus.fasta, and mapping_report.txt. The tool used must be the 'UGENE Genome Aligner'.
